overview.description: The Pacer Swan SOS Conservative (April) ETF (PSCW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund aims for specific buffered losses and capped gains on SPDR S&P 500 ETF over a one-year period. The actively managed fund holds options and collateral. PSCW was launched on Mar 31, 2021 and is issued by Pacer.
